response.title: which floor rising projector screen sets up the fastest
response.answer:
For the fastest setup, choose a motorized floor-rising projector screen rather than a manual pull-up model.

There are two different speeds worth comparing:

Deployment time: How many seconds the screen takes to rise fully.

Total setup time: How long it takes from carrying the screen into a room to having it ready for projection.

Motorized screens generally win for convenience: place the case on the floor, plug it in, and press a button. Manual screens can be faster to raise, but often require more physical adjustment.
